long_description: Document Systems helps users compose deterministic proposal Expressions, validate structural and evidence boundaries, inspect supplied lineage, and render traceable review or action views. Four bounded profiles cover normative, operational, research, and human-agent documents. Every result remains proposal-scoped and not persisted; validation never claims source truth, authority, behavioral success, acceptance, operative status, repository head, or complete lineage.
capabilities: Validate structure, evidence boundaries, and supplied lineage
Render traceable human-review, human-action, and machine views
starter_prompts: Model this policy requirement as a proposal-scoped normative Expression.
Audit this Expression's integrity, readiness, lineage, and evidence boundaries.
Render a traceable human-action view from this operational Expression.
release_notes: Initial universal-directory submission for Document Systems 0.2.0. Adds a production stateless Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, explicit tool safety annotations and output schemas, public Banks Inc. publication pages, and reviewer-ready positive and negative test cases. No authentication or demo credentials are required.
